profile.role: Frontend Development Lead · Senior Frontend Engineer
profile.description-1: I am a Systems Engineer with +{years} years of experience building scalable web applications for enterprise B2B clients. I specialize in frontend development, architecture, and technical leadership.
profile.description-2: I currently develop a wholesale e-commerce platform for the U.S. and Canada using Next.js, React, and TypeScript. I have led architecture standards and frontend modernization, connecting interfaces with APIs and services in Node.js and .NET. I work with Figma designs and AI-assisted workflows to take solutions from concept to production.
profile.title: Hey, I'm Faber Grajales

education.systems-engineer-description: After obtaining my first job with the knowledge I acquired at SENA, I paid for my university, I worked during the day and studied at night, with a lot of effort and sacrifice I was able to finish my studies and graduate as a Systems Engineer.
education.adsi: Technologist in Analysis and Development of Information Systems
education.adsi-description: Without having many resources and with a computer that barely survived, I started studying at SENA, performing with great academic performance.
education.adsi-description-2: Together with two other colleagues, we represented the Quindío region in the national SenaSoft competitions (2017) in the web development competition.
education.technical-bachelor-description: In high school, I enrolled in the Systems modality since I was always attracted to technology, it is here where I became passionate about development, I enjoyed seeing the software classes with Scratch and flowcharts every week, begging to start programming, but today I am grateful for the good teachers I had and the good foundations they planted in me, helping me develop critical reasoning and problem-solving.

experience.job-1-description-1: Delivered enterprise B2B web applications for brands including Postobón, Nutresa, Ramo, and Alquería. Led frontend modernization, migrating .NET WebForms applications to Vue.js and React.js.
experience.job-1-description-2: Managed SQL Server databases, stored procedures, query optimization, and ETL processes supporting business operations. Stack: JavaScript · React.js · Vue.js · .NET Framework · C# · VB · SQL Server · SQLite.
experience.job-2-description-1: Built a full-stack credit eligibility system for Banco Popular, integrating REST APIs with the repository pattern and Entity Framework Core.
experience.job-2-description-2: Implemented a HealthChecker for proactive monitoring of service availability and performance. Stack: Angular · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · .NET Core 5 · C# · SQL Server.
experience.job-3-description-1: Defined frontend architecture standards and led technical decisions, technology evaluation, migration strategies, and code reviews. Worked with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and migrated state management from Redux Toolkit to Zustand to reduce complexity.
experience.job-3-description-2: Built a Drag & Drop survey generator with conditional logic and real-time preview, and a dynamic reporting system with ECharts for tables, charts, and maps. Integrated .NET Core services and optimized APIs and SQL Server queries. Stack: React.js · Next.js · TypeScript · Zustand · TanStack Query · Ant Design · Tailwind CSS · ECharts · .NET Core · C# · SQL Server.
experience.job-4-description-1: Building the storefront of a B2B wholesale e-commerce platform for the U.S. and Canada, in a Next.js 15, React 19, and TypeScript monorepo with a BFF over Azure Functions and Contentstack CMS.
experience.job-4-description-2: Shipped product, cart, and checkout flows, including guest and authenticated purchases, shipping restrictions, and place-order error handling. Integrated commerce APIs with TanStack Query and Zustand.
experience.job-4-description-3: Delivered account features, saved lists with search, sorting, and line totals, and order-detail views, aligning frontend contracts with APIs.
experience.job-4-description-4: Implemented Figma designs as production interfaces with design tokens and Tailwind CSS across desktop and mobile. Built AI-assisted workflows from Jira and Figma to generate typed components, mocks, and stories consistently.
experience.job-4-description-5: Stack: React 19 · Next.js 15 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Zustand · TanStack Query · GraphQL · Contentstack · Azure Functions · Figma · Jira · Cursor · Claude Code · Datadog.
